module traffic_light (
    input clk, reset,
    output [2:0] light
);

reg [2:0] light;

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
        light <= 3'b101;  // Reset state is '101' (Red for traffic light 0, Yellow for 1, Red for 2 in this case)
    end
    else begin
        case (light) 
            3'b101: light <= 3'b101;  // Red (stop) for traffic light 0
            3'b110: light <= 3'b011;  // Red (stop) for traffic light 1
            3'b111: light <= 3'b011;  // Green (go) for traffic light 2
            default: light <= 3'b101;  // In the absence of a match, default to the initial state
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule

module log2_int (
    input signed [15:0] in_0,
    output signed [7:0] out
);
    reg [7:0] out_temp;
    always @(in_0) begin
        // Determination of the log2 of a number based on the number of bits set in the number
        // This code should implement the given circuit from the circuit diagram, using the specified I/O types.
        // Functionality of the circuit: roughly log2 of the number.
        if (in_0 == 0) begin
            out_temp = 8'b00000000;
        end
        else if (in_0 < 0) begin
            out_temp = 8'b10000000; // possibly negative output, or consider absolute value? 
        end
        else begin
            case (in_0) 8'b00000001: out_temp = 8'b00000000; // lone bit at position 1, log2=0
                8'b00000010: out_temp = 8'b00000001; // bit set at 2, log2=1
                8'b00000100: out_temp = 8'b00000010; // bit set at 4, log2=2
                8'b00001000: out_temp = 8'b00000100; // bit set at 8, log2=3
                8'b00010000: out_temp = 8'b00001000; // bit set at 16, log2=4
                8'b00100000: out_temp = 8'b00010000; // bit set at 32, log2=5
                8'b01000000: out_temp = 8'b00100000; // bit set at 64, log2=6
                8'b10000000: out_temp = 8'b01000000; // bit set at 128, log2=7
                default: out_temp = 8'b01111111; // for numbers have multiple bits set, the log2 is the maximum position of the bit set.
        endcase
    end
    assign out = out_temp;
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input resetn,
  input [1:0] byteena,
  input [15:0] d,
  output reg [15:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk or negedge resetn) begin
    if (!resetn) begin
      q <= 0;
    end else begin
      for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) begin
        if (byteena[i] == 1) begin
          q[i] <= d[i];
        end
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input [7:0] d,
  input areset,
  output reg [7:0] q
);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
    if (areset == 1'b1) begin
      q <= 8'b0;
    end else begin
      q <= {q[6:0], d[0]};
    end
  end
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input areset,
  input x,
  output z
);
  reg [1:0] qp, qp0; // 2-bit register for output of the DFFs
  wire [1:0] Q, Q0;  // 2-bit output of DFFs

  // FF for the first stage
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (areset) begin
      Q <= 2'b00; // areset active low, clear to zero
    end
    else begin
      Q <= Q0;    // input to next state is output of the previous state
    end
  end

  // FF for the second stage
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (areset) begin
      Q0 <= 2'b00; // areset active low, clear to zero
    end
    else begin
      Q0 <= {Q[0], Q[1]}; // output continuous; select first bit of Q, second bit shifted left
    end
  end

  // Input to gate
  assign z = &({!Q0, x} & {Q, x});  // AND gate at the output of Q and x, then finally produce a single output
endmodule

  input c,
  input d,
  output out
);

  wire w5 = c & w4;  // third row from the bottom
  wire w4 = b & w3;  // fourth row from the bottom

  wire w2 = (a | b) & (c | d);  // identical to w3,作為第六行從底部
  wire w1 = (a | b) & (c | d);  // and the seventh row from the bottom
  wire out = (w10 | w9 | w8 | w7) & w2;  // top-level OR of terms and the bottom AND
endmodule
